name: kanban_update
description: Change a card's title, notes, assignee, priority or deadline. Assigning or setting a deadline is announced in the board's chatroom; editing text is not.
llm_description: Update a card's title, body, who/assignee (empty to unassign), priority (low/normal/high), or deadline (unix seconds, 0 = none). Assigning or setting deadline is announced in the board room; text edits are not.

who.description: Instance name to assign to, or empty to unassign

assignee.description: Alias of who; instance name to assign to, or empty to unassign

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
